text:
Alice Chen: Heads up — Sentry ingestion looks flaky. I'm seeing spikes of 502/503 from sentry-ingest and a bunch of exceptions missing from the dashboard. Not matching error counts in Datadog. Anyone else?
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2024-451. PagerDuty alert sent to on-call. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2024-451
Marcus Ortega: I can confirm. Our metrics show many `store` endpoint 5xxs to sentry (eu1). Start time ~ 1714200860 (approx 15m).
Priya Nair: Checking Sentry status — they're reporting degraded ingestion in EU region: https://status.sentry.io/ (note: status page intermittent).
Alice Chen: That would explain gaps. Customer-facing errors are likely underreported. Quick ask — can we enable a fallback so errors at least land in logs or Datadog until Sentry recovers?
Marcus Ortega: I'm triggering emergency logging patch on backfill-service. Will flip `SENTRY_DSN` to empty and enable local console transport for SDKs. Patch queued: #PR-2048.
Jamie Park: Copy. On support side, I'm flagging active CS tickets that mentioned missing stack traces — they may need manual triage if we won't get exceptions.
Andrew Li: For services that can't be redeployed quickly, we can forward critical events to Datadog logs via HTTP. Sample curl to post a JSON log (Datadog):
```
curl -s -X POST https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input \
  -H 'DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"message":"fallback-error","service":"backfill-service","error":"<stack trace>"}'
```
Marcus Ortega: Also enabling enhanced local logging on k8s for the next 30m: set env `LOG_LEVEL=debug` and `SENTRY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT=5000` on pods with high error rates.
Priya Nair: Reached out to Sentry support via portal and opened ticket SR-98762. Their automated response shows elevated errors but delayed ingestion. ETA unclear.
Seana Gupta: Customer impact quick assessment: for last 20m -> approx 1200 unique exceptions not visible in Sentry. Most from SDK-init path on mobile sync. Potentially delays in triage and overall SLA reporting.
Alice Chen: Action list so far: 1) Emergency logging patches/deploys (Marcus/Andrew) 2) Forward critical errors to Datadog (Andrew) 3) Flag/support tickets for manual triage (Jamie) 4) Contact Sentry support and escalate if ETA > 30m (Priya) 5) Create incident ticket in JIRA and attach quick postmortem template (I'll create).
Incident Bot: JIRA ticket created: REDWOOD-INC-451 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-INC-451).
Marcus Ortega: Deploys rolling now. Load spikes causing backoff on sentry clients — we should also reduce sampling to 0.5 for non-critical logs to lower load on SDKs.
Jamie Park: Handing off to @Seana for overnight follow-up at 06:00 UTC. Seana — can you take the next 2h check and update incident log?
Seana Gupta: Taking handoff. I'll monitor Sentry status, Datadog forwarding, and support queue. If Sentry not recovered by +30m, escalate to Sentry on-call and consider re-ingestion plan for missing events.
Andrew Li: One-off helper snippet to add to services that can't redeploy quickly — a thin error-proxy that accepts events and writes to files for later ingest: 
```
# run as job on node with access to PVC
nc -l 18181 > /var/log/sentry-fallback/queued-errors.log
# then curl -> http://node:18181  to push events
```
Priya Nair: Sentry responded to SR-98762: "We're investigating high-latency in EU region ingestion; internal mitigation underway." No ETA. I've requested priority escalation.
deploy-bot: Deployment redwood/backfill-service v2.14.7 -> success (rolling) — 3/4 pods updated.
Alice Chen: Nice. Keep the Deploy logs and any failed requests (5xx) attached to the JIRA ticket. We need evidence for re-ingestion if Sentry supports it.
Seana Gupta: Noted. I'll add a log export of `sentry.store.*` 5xxs and upload to the JIRA. Also tagging CS with a note to hold on triage until we confirm ingestion for the window.
Marcus Ortega: FYI — we've set temporary alert to page if Datadog logs for `fallback-error` exceed 50/min so we don't miss real spikes.
Alice Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the incident lead notes and postmortem template in REDWOOD-INC-451. If anyone sees Sentry fully recover, ping here and mark `incident:monitoring` resolved.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2024-451 status updated -> monitoring.
Seana Gupta: Update at 06:15 UTC — Sentry ingestion showing partial recovery, but still sampling/dropping some events. Continuing monitoring.
Alice Chen: Marking last log for thread; will update JIRA with final timeline after 1hr. Good handoff @Seana. :thumbsup:
